title: The audio chain: being heard and hearing

facts.name: audio.mic_state
facts.doc: Whether a seat's microphone was muted or unmuted, held over a window. Claim: muted or unmuted.

facts.name: audio.ingress
facts.doc: A rollup of a seat's audio packets at SFU ingress over exactly its window. Values: packets, voiced.

facts.name: audio.capture
facts.doc: A rollup of a seat's microphone level before WebRTC over exactly its window. Values: rms_max_dbfs.

symptoms.doc: The Participant's microphone is on but others can't hear them.

witnesses.query: axiom <api-log-dataset> | where episode_id == '{episode}' and participant_id == '{participant}' and event == 'sdk.mic_state' | where _time between (datetime({from}) .. datetime({to}))
witnesses.doc: When the seat's microphone was unmuted.

witnesses.query: axiom <api-log-dataset> | where episode_id == '{episode}' and participant_id == '{participant}' and event == 'sfu.media.ingress' and media_kind == 'audio' | where _time between (datetime({from}) .. datetime({to}))
witnesses.doc: Whether voiced packets reached the SFU while it was unmuted.
The capture level, which attributes a silent ingress to a client hop.

symptoms.doc: The Participant can't hear someone who is speaking.
